import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    w = int(next(it))
    a = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    cuts = []
    even = 0
    odd = 0
    for i in range(n - 1):
        if a[i] % 2 == 0:
            even += 1
        else:
            odd += 1
        if even == odd:
            cuts.append(abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]))
    dp = [0] * (w + 1)
    for cost in cuts:
        for j in range(w, cost - 1, -1):
            if dp[j - cost] + 1 > dp[j]:
                dp[j] = dp[j - cost] + 1
    print(dp[w])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
